title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-off tech, energy spikes, oil surge. Large cap tech and semiconductors sold off sharply, with QQQ -2.04% and SOXX -5.38%, while oil surged +7.32% propelling XLE +1.88%. Options show heavy put demand (SPY PCR 1.43) and VIX at 20.7 above its 20-day MA, indicating elevated fear. The day's character was a rotation out of AI/semis into energy and staples, driven by KLAC earnings miss and supply-driven oil spike.

INDICES — VIX 20.7, up 6.07%. Rank by 1d: SPY -1.54%, IWM -1.64%, QQQ -2.04%, DIA -2.18%, SOXX -5.38%. Small > large by 0.18pp. Notable cross-asset: oil +7.32% vs tech crash. QQQ at 20d -10.14% is likely below its 200-day MA, a CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME — SPY volume near index average 1.78x, not explicitly flagged; QQQ vol_ratio 1.6x (declining volume) with price down = low-conviction selling. XLK volume 1.7x elevated with price down 2.64% = distribution. Energy volume (XLE 1.2x) low, indicating low-conviction rally.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.88%, XLP Staples +0.34%, XLRE Real Estate -0.11%, XLC Comms -0.15%, XLV Healthcare -0.61%, XLY Discretionary -0.77%, XLB Materials -1.15%, XLU Utilities -1.34%, XLF Financials -1.60%, XLK Technology -2.64%, XLI Industrials -3.19%. Top industries: USO +7.32%, FCG +3.84%. Bottom: SMH -4.79%, SOXX -5.38%. Money rotating out of tech and industrials into energy and staples. Rotation state: 'AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation'.

POSITIONING — SPY put-call vol ratio 1.43, QQQ 1.35, IWM 2.02 — elevated protection demand. IV skew positive for SPY (+8.5%) indicating put premium. VIX at 20.7 above 20-day MA of 17.2, confirming fear. GEX flip levels not available for equity indices; GLD flip at 375, near current price.

CROSS-ASSET — Sharp divergence between oil +7.32% and tech (XLK -2.64%, SOXX -5.38%) suggests supply-side shock repricing, with dollar -0.56% adding tailwind to commodities but not enough to offset semiconductor sell-off.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 61.2 (Greed) despite cautious options. Top movers: VRT -17.26% (distribution, 4.6x vol), MDLZ +4.02% (accumulation, 2.3x vol), TT -4.94% (distribution, 2.3x vol). 20d momentum extremes: XLE +10.43% best sector, XLK -12.57% worst; USO +21.49% best basket, SOXX -27.43% worst. KLAC chip weakness catalyst. Watch tomorrow: VRT (distribution, possible follow-through), SOXX (momentum break, gamma risk), USO (overbought, cross-asset signal).
